newsitem.title: USA: Crompton & Knowles Q4 shr profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Crompton & Knowles Q4 shr profit vs loss.

text.p: Fourth quarter and year ended 1996 and 1995

NOTE: For the year, earnings were $64.6 million, or $0.90 per share, before after-tax merger and related costs of $68.1 million, a special charge for environmental costs of $18.5 million, and an extraordinary charge of $0.5 million compared with earnings of $56.6 million, or $0.85 per share, in 1995.
The 1995 results exclude $78.9 million of special tax credits, an extraordinary charge of $8.3 million and other special income, net of $4.4 million.
Crompton & Knowles Corp and Uniroyal Chemical Corp merged in August 1996 and the merger is being accounted for on a pooling-of-interests basis.
Accordingly, the results of Uniroyal for 1995 and prior fiscal years ending in September are being combined with Crompton & Knowles' results for its fiscal years ending in December.
The reported results for 1995 include Uniroyal's results for the fourth quarter of calendar 1994 rather than calendar 1995.
